instruction.text: A fencer needs to build a fence that is 1.5 kilometres long. One section of fence is 25 metres. How many sections of fence does the fencer need to buy?

atoms.b: Therefore, the fencer needs to buy <mat><gap>60</gap></mat> sections of fence.

instruction.text: There are 20 pencils in a small pack. There are 500 pencils in a large pack. How many small packs make one large pack?
The mass of the pencils in the large pack is 3.2 kilograms. What is the mass of one pencil, in grams?

atoms.b: Therefore, the mass of one pencil is 6.4g.

instruction.text: There are 50 rubbers in a small pack. There are 3,000 rubbers in a large pack. How many small packs make one large pack?
The mass of one rubber is 5.4 grams. What is the mass of one large pack, in kilograms?

atoms.b: Therefore, the mass of one large pack is <mat><gap>16.2</gap></mat>kg.

instruction.text: A school orders one large pack of pens. A large pack contains 600 pens. One pen is 4.5 grams. What is the mass of the pack in kilograms?

atoms.b: Therefore, the mass of one large pack of pens is <mat><gap>2.7</gap></mat>kg.

instruction.text: There are 550 workbooks in a large box. The school needs 6,600 notebooks. One large box costs £259.99. How much will the workbooks cost the school?

atoms.b: Therefore, the workbooks will cost the school £<mat><gap>3119.88</gap></mat>.
